newsitem.title: CHINA: China capital population up 0.7 pct, tops 12 mln.
newsitem.headline: China capital population up 0.7 pct, tops 12 mln.

text.p: The population of China's capital Beijing rose by 0.7 percent in 1996 to hit 12.59 million people, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The figure included people who had lived in the city for at least six months, Xinhua quoted official statistics as showing.
The registered permanent population of the city reached 10.77 million last year, also a rise of 0.7 percent, the agency said.
The municipality had 9.19 million urban dwellers while rural residents numbered 3.4 million, it said.
Some 13.13 percent of Beijing residents were over the age of 60, it said, but gave no further details.
Nearly three-quarters of China's 1.2 billion people live in rural areas but more and more farmers have abandoned their villages to seek their fortunes in the thriving cities.
